description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Ice/Dark, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Edea (Ice, Dark)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Edea (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Increases [Ice/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Ice or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Edea (Ice, Dark) after using two Ice or Dark abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Ice Strike+
description.text: Four single attacks (3.80 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to self

description.name: Astral Realm+
description.text: Five single attacks (3.80/3.95 each), capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Edea (Dark/Fire)
description.text: Six single attacks (2.70 each), 3.05 if exploiting Ice or Dark weakness, capped at 19999

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
